meta.siteDescription: Premium Nepali cuisine in Japan with bilingual menu, reservation, gallery, and ordering previews.

shell.brandTagline: Nepali hospitality, composed for evenings in Japan
shell.footerNote: The frontend currently runs in isolated mock mode while the Django REST API is under development. Reservation confirmation, final pricing, taxes, delivery fees, and payment status remain backend-owned.

HomePage.title: Premium Nepali dining, shaped for evenings in Japan.
HomePage.description: Move from the menu to reservations, gallery, and checkout previews in a bilingual guest journey designed to feel calm, warm, and unmistakably restaurant-first while the backend is still under development.
HomePage.atmosphereTitle: A quieter way to discover the room
HomePage.atmosphereDescription: Explore the atmosphere, review guest touchpoints, and move through the bilingual preview at a composed pace.
HomePage.previewDescription: Browse dishes, compare variants and add-ons, and carry selections into the shared cart without overstating frontend pricing authority.
HomePage.visitDescription: Request a table, share guest details, and preview the dining flow while final availability and confirmation remain backend-managed.
HomePage.mockModeDescription: This landing page still runs on isolated mock data. Final reservation confirmation, order acceptance, taxes, delivery fees, and payment status will come from the Django API once it is ready.

ReservationPage.title: Request a reservation with a preview-first flow.
ReservationPage.description: This page collects reservation details, offers an advisory availability preview, and submits a typed request through the service layer.
ReservationPage.previewDescription: Preview results are advisory only. Final confirmation and conflict checks remain backend-owned.
ReservationPage.previewError: The preview request could not be completed.
ReservationPage.previewIdle: Choose a date and guest count, then request preview availability.
ReservationPage.previewUnavailable: No preview time slots were returned.
ReservationPage.timeSlotPlaceholder: Preview time slots will appear here after you request availability.
ReservationPage.specialRequestHint: Optional notes are helpful, but final accommodation depends on backend confirmation.
ReservationPage.submitError: The reservation request could not be completed.
ReservationPage.sidebarDescription: The frontend gathers intent and clearly separates advisory preview data from final backend confirmation.
ReservationPage.confirmationDescription: A successful frontend submit still represents a request. The backend remains the final authority for reservation confirmation, conflicts, and timing.

CartPage.title: Review the current cart before continuing to checkout.
CartPage.description: This page reads from the shared cart store and keeps pricing intentionally non-authoritative until the backend confirms totals and fees.
CartPage.emptyDescription: Browse the menu to start a preview order. Added items will appear here immediately through the shared cart store.
CartPage.integrationNote: Item names, variants, and estimated line totals are already shown here, while final pricing and acceptance still belong to the backend.
CartPage.pricingNote: Pricing remains a preview concern for now. Final totals, taxes, and delivery fees stay backend-authoritative.

CheckoutPage.title: Submit a typed order request while final totals stay backend-owned.
CheckoutPage.description: This page validates customer input with Zod and react-hook-form, maps values into the service layer, and keeps order acceptance, fees, and payment state with the backend.
CheckoutPage.emptyTitle: Checkout needs at least one cart item.
CheckoutPage.emptyDescription: Return to the menu or cart to continue your preview order before submitting checkout.
CheckoutPage.emptyError: Add at least one item to the cart before submitting checkout.
CheckoutPage.submitError: The order request could not be completed.
CheckoutPage.estimatedDescription: This page does not claim final backend pricing authority. Any preview total returned after submit is still advisory until the backend confirms the order.

ContactPage.title: Reach the restaurant through a clear bilingual contact flow.
ContactPage.description: These forms validate customer input for clarity, submit through the existing service layer, and avoid persisting personal data in shared state.
ContactPage.contactHint: Frontend checks help with clarity, but backend handling remains the final authority for message processing.
ContactPage.contactSuccess: Your contact message has been sent.
ContactPage.contactError: The contact message could not be sent.
ContactPage.newsletterDescription: A minimal newsletter signup stays separate from the contact flow and uses the existing newsletter service without storing personal data in shared state.
ContactPage.newsletterHint: Subscription handling and final mailing behavior remain backend-managed.
ContactPage.newsletterSuccess: Your newsletter signup has been received.
ContactPage.newsletterError: The newsletter signup could not be submitted.

MenuPage.title: Browse a bilingual menu preview shaped for guest decisions.
MenuPage.description: This menu page reads from the existing service layer, localizes backend-style fields, and connects add-to-cart behavior without claiming final pricing authority.
MenuPage.availabilityAvailable: Available to add in this mock preview.
MenuPage.cartSummaryDescription: The menu page can feed the shared cart store with cart-safe item selections only.
MenuPage.pricingDisclaimer: All menu pricing shown here is preview-oriented. Final totals, fees, taxes, and acceptance remain backend-authoritative.

MenuDetailPage.availabilityAvailable: Currently available to add in this mock preview.
MenuDetailPage.pricingDescription: Displayed prices are preview-oriented. Final totals, fees, taxes, and order acceptance remain backend-authoritative.
MenuDetailPage.detailNoteDescription: This page focuses on localized menu content, cart-safe item selection, and clear boundaries around backend-owned pricing and availability.

GalleryPage.title: Step into the room, the plating, and the evening rhythm.
GalleryPage.description: This gallery page reads from the existing gallery service layer and presents CMS-shaped visual entries without unsafe rich-content rendering or heavy client-side effects.
GalleryPage.emptyDescription: When more gallery content is available through the service layer, this page will continue to present it as lightweight, optimized visual storytelling.
